about: Where the road runs on the titan (its deck seated just over the titan, slab bottom 6.2 m under the deck) and where it passes through it (the titan open round it). Distances along the road; see road.json for the samples.

on.note: climbs over the fingertips and the open palm, rising to the wrist
along the top of the forearm, palm up
climbs off the upper arm, over the top of the right shoulder armour and onto the chest (over the upper arm it rises clear of it: pylons stand on the arm there)
north along the top of the chest by the collarbone
turns west off the chest onto the chin
over the face and forehead, down the middle, between the horns: the head tipped forward on its broken neck and propped up (pose.json head)

through.note: rolls a full turn through the standing ring
in through the wound in the left (north) flank
a full loop inside the ribs: the chest hollow round it
a fork: the left route through walled and roofed corridors, the right (the gallery) high along the ribs, open on its outside
out through an opening in the right (south) flank
twice round the blade, the blade under the deck all the way

past.note: down past the crown and between the horns, clear of them, to the Halo

past.piece: up to the hilt, over the crossguard
past.note: up to the hilt and over the top onto the blade on one long arc, passing over the guard just before the corkscrew: the guard lies inside the corkscrew's radius from the blade, so the road cannot rest on it, and does not have to
